name: Qui Nhơn
summary: A coastal city and U.S. logistics hub in south-central Vietnam. Larry touched down here as a refueling stop on a marathon 4 a.m.–11 p.m. day of flying aboard Rosethorn 007 — and it was at the Qui Nhơn PX that he bought the camera (a Canon Dial 35) behind much of this collection.
larrysRecollection: One time took off at 4am, refilled at Qui Nhon, and that where I bought my camera the PX - Post Xchange army store. (VN-0016 Memories comment, 2026-08-15)
researchNotes: Chiefly significant for the collection's own provenance: the camera purchase dates nothing precisely, but photos taken with Larry's own camera necessarily postdate this stop. The Canon Dial 35 was introduced in 1963, consistent with a 1964–65 PX purchase.
